Tu as déjà travaillé en PHP/Symfony, ou tu viens d'un autre écosystème mais tu as démontré ta capacité à switcher rapidement de stack, et tu es à l'aise pour évoluer dans un monolithe en transition vers une architecture plus modulaire.Ce qui fera la différence :Tu ne vois pas les tests comme une corvée après coup : chez nous, du test unitaire à l'end-to-end, ils font partie de la routine.Tu as déjà intégré des outils d'IA générative à ton workflow de dev (Claude Code, Copilot ou équivalent) et tu sais que la vraie valeur réside dans la façon dont tu les pilotes.Tu es à l'aise pour sortir de ton périmètre strict en mode fullstack : un peu de front, un peu d'infra, selon ce qu'il y a à faire.L'impact de ton code : Travailler sur un logiciel de télésurveillance cardiaque, ce n'est pas pousser du code dans le vide : chaque fonctionnalité que tu livres a un impact direct sur le suivi de patients réels, souvent fragiles, et sur le quotidien des professionnels de santé qui s'appuient dessus.C'est un secteur exigeant : la rigueur sur les tests et la qualité de code n'est pas là pour cocher une case, elle a un sens concret dans un environnement très réglementé (dispositif médical de classe IIa). jobs.title: PHP Developer
jobs.description: GBL Tech | PHP DeveloperAt GBL Tech, we drive high-impact technology careers through specialization and scale. We operate across critical digital ecosystems — from Fintech to Smart Industry — connecting talent with technically challenging projects and modern stacks.The RoleWe're looking for a PHP Application Developer to join a technical team focused on building and evolving robust business applications. This role is suited for a developer who goes beyond web development, working at application level to design, implement, and maintain reliable software solutions using modern PHP frameworks and relational databases.Your Mission:Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain business-critical applications using PHP, with a strong focus on application logic and software quality.Backend Engineering: Build and enhance application components using Symfony and/or Laravel, following clean, maintainable, and scalable development practices.Database Development: Work extensively with MySQL, designing and optimizing data structures and ensuring efficient application-to-database interactions.Application Evolution: Analyse existing solutions, implement new functionalities, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve application performance and reliability.Technical Collaboration: Work closely with other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective application solutions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the platform.What We Are Looking For:PHP Expertise: 4–5 years of professional experience as a PHP Application Developer, with strong hands-on development experience.Framework Knowledge: Solid experience with Symfony and/or Laravel.Database Skills: Strong practical knowledge of MySQL and relational database concepts.Application Mindset: Experience developing and maintaining applications, with a focus on backend logic, scalability, maintainability, and performance rather than traditional website development.Engineering Practices: Ability to work autonomously, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute effectively within a collaborative development environment.Interested?If this project speaks to you, or you're looking for a similar challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel)
jobs.description: About PactFiPrivate asset markets (PE, Private Credit, VC, Real Estate) have 10x to 9.8T in AUM over the past decade and are projected to grow to $17T in the next five years. However, digital infrastructure has not kept pace, with most of the market operating predominantly in error-prone, internal-only software solutions.PactFi provides secure, end-to-end, operational infrastructure for managing complex private credit transactions. Our web-based application brings together all parties involved in such a transaction to more efficiently allocate capital, complete KYC, share documents, manage funds flow, and more. The platform is secured to a bank-grade standard, and we have received our SOC 2 Type 2 attestation.PactFi was developed in close partnership with two of the industry's largest players, both of whom represent the top 3 players in the private credit space by both size (AUM) and deal activity.PactFi is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build and ship features across our platform. You'll work primarily in our Laravel codebase, with regular front-end work in Vue.js, on products that move real money for our partners and their clients.This is a hands-on role for an engineer with a couple of years under their belt who wants to grow quickly. You'll own features end to end with support from senior engineers, and you'll get direct exposure to product, QA, and engineering leadership rather than working from a ticket queue.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and ship features in our Laravel application, from database schema through API endpoints to the Vue.js interface. Write clean, tested, well-documented code and participate actively in code review. Integrate with third-party APIs and internal services, handling errors, retries, and edge cases thoughtfully. Work with Product Managers and QA to clarify requirements, break down work, and get features to production. Debug and resolve issues across the stack, including performance and data-integrity problems. Contribute to improving our tooling, tests, and development workflow. Solid PHP fundamentals and comfort with object-oriented design. Front-end experience with Vue.js, React, or similar, plus solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. jobs.description: Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)LucidHorizon · Porto e LisboaRemoto em Portugal ou presencial · Contrato sem termo · 50.000 a 70.000 € brutos/ano + stock options.Sobre a LucidHorizonEstamos a preparar as empresas para o futuro. Construímos software com inteligência artificial que automatiza o trabalho repetitivo e devolve às pessoas o tempo para o que realmente conta: as relações e o trabalho de maior valor. O nosso alvo é o grosso do tecido empresarial português, milhares de PMEs que ainda trabalham como há vinte anos, e a nossa ambição é redefinir a forma como elas operam. Em 2027 levamos isto para fora de Portugal.Temos hoje três produtos em crescimento:CRAFTEER, o produto principal: o ambiente de trabalho digital de mediadores e revendedores. Junta ERP/CRM, plataformas de fornecedores e email, WhatsApp e SMS num único sistema, com IA a dar contexto em tempo real a quem vende.Mimic Task: aprende o que as pessoas fazem em websites (consultas, recolhas, preenchimentos) e transforma isso num robô que repete os passos sozinho.Scriva: transcreve, analisa e resume chamadas e reuniões e liga-as ao cliente certo no ERP ou CRM.Somos uma equipa pequena, jovem e ambiciosa, e é exatamente por isso que esta oportunidade de fazer parte de uma projeto com enorme potencial e montada para a escalar. O que decidires construir vai estar em clientes reais em semanas. Irás ter um papel importante na definição da arquitetura de novos desenvolvimentos e suportarás a expansão internacional.O que vais fazerSer a referência de dev backend na empresa.Construir o core das nossas tecnologias em Laravel: integrações com ERPs, CRMs e APIs de fornecedores, filas e eventos, APIs internas.Definir com o CTO os padrões técnicos que todos os produtos vão seguir.Trabalhar de perto com o CPO no ciclo de produto e ajudar a escolher quem entra a seguir na equipa.Quem procuramosMais de 8 anos de PHP em produção e Laravel em projetos a sério.Experiência a integrar sistemas externos, e a noção do que isso custa.SQL forte, idealmente em PostgreSQL, cuidado com performance e capacidade de decidir sozinho.Vontade de construir numa fase inicial, com tudo o que isso tem de bom e de exigente.Bónus: SaaS multi-tenant, filas e eventos, APIs de IA.O que oferecemosContrato sem termo entre 50.000 e 70.000 € brutos/ano, conforme a experiência.Stock options: quem constrói a empresa deve ser dono de uma parte dela.Remoto em Portugal ou presencial no Porto ou em Lisboa, à tua escolha.Vários produtos com IA
